name: Alcorn

ranking.rule: standard competition ranking: ties share the best place (T-3, T-3, T-3, then 6th); the last place is N of N unless tied (four tied for last of 12 are T-9).

scope: Games between two of the 18 with play-by-play, unless a block says otherwise (the header's games and record use every game).

epa_chart.note: The conference line is the mean of the conference's teams' game values that week, games with play-by-play only. Offense and defense differ in a week where conference teams played outside opponents.

metrics.label: Air yards per attempt (aDOT)
metrics.definition: Air yards to the caught / thrown-to / intercepted spot, charted throws only.

metrics.label: Yards after catch per completion
metrics.definition: Credited yards (play_yardage.credited_yards) less air yards, completions with a charted spot.

metrics.label: Run again after a stuffed run
metrics.definition: On 2nd or 3rd down, the snap right after a run stuffed for 0 or less in the same drive: share that are runs.

metrics.label: Success running right after a stuff
metrics.definition: Success rate of those follow-up runs.

metrics.label: Success passing right after a stuff
metrics.definition: Success rate of follow-up passes after a stuffed run.

metrics.label: Run rate, late and close
metrics.definition: 4th quarter or overtime, within one score (play_filters.is_late_and_close_state): runs / (runs + dropbacks).

metrics.label: Rush success, late and close
metrics.definition: Success rate of late-and-close carries.

metrics.label: Yards per carry, late and close
metrics.definition: Rush yards / carries, late and close.

metrics.label: Stuff rate, late and close
metrics.definition: Carries for 0 or less, late and close.

metrics.label: Goal-to-go rush TD rate
metrics.definition: Carries with goal to go (play_filters.is_goal_to_go_snap) that scored.

metrics.label: Share of rush yards from explosive runs

metrics.label: QB rush success

players.scope: Games between two of the 18. Ranks: the league order of each published value among qualified players.

context.rule: Every ranked metric in this file whose conference rank sits in the top or bottom quarter (rank position <= 25% or >= 75% of the field), with at least 8 in its sample where the metric carries one. Ordered by distance from the middle (extremity 1 = first or last; level ones put headline measures first, then untied, then the league rank); counts (blocks, TDs) are never picked; at most 2 per unit, up to 5 strengths and 5 weaknesses, topped up from either side. A sort of published values: nothing is computed.
